region_order: HoS 1. Evil's Soft First Touches (32): accept Rose on a Red Field when leaving; loot Garin manor first.
HoS 2. Optional anytime: Without a Trace, Taxman Cometh (35k crowns), Enchanting x2, From Ofier's Distant Shores, treasure hunts.
HoS 3. Dead Man's Party (33): do wedding activities; then A Midnight Clear before leaving the wedding.
HoS 4. Open Sesame! (34): Mignole four diagrams, correct painting + buy it, buy figurine, Hilbert Gwent; then the 3 subquests. Order of 3 and 4 is free.
HoS 5. Avid Collector, A Dark Legacy any time after 4.
HoS 6. Scenes From a Marriage (35) needs both 3 and 4.
HoS 7. Whatsoever a Man Soweth... (36): play Shani Gwent, see Shani then Shakeslock, save, Temple, challenge O'Dimm.
BW 1. Envoys, Wineboys (needs A Poet Under Pressure; delay accepting until ready) -> The Beast of Toussaint -> Blood Run.

BW 2. Warble of a Smitten Knight (starts after shaelmaar) and win tournament; Turn and Face the Strange, side quests, Skellige Gwent deck, Fists of Fury; play Pheasantry innkeeper before entering the Gwent tournament.
BW 3. La Cage au Fou -> Amidst the Mill's Grist -> Where Children Toil -> Wine is Sacred -> The Man from Cintra.
BW 4. Before Capture the Castle: finish Warble and all open side quests (point of no return for side content; no manual saves).

BW 5. Capture the Castle -> Night of Long Fangs -> Blood Simple (optional) -> save before wardrobe book -> Beyond Hill and Dale (ribbon, bean talks, Duck Duck Goosed) -> save -> Tesham Mutna -> Pomp (Syanna first) -> Be It Ever So Humble.
BW 6. Separate saves needed for What Lies Unseen, Burlap and Perks of Being a Jailbird.
